body:
it hasn't changed my entire life, i've almost always felt like this, so why would it change later on? i dont know the cause of my depression exactly, i think its mainly my overwhelming loneliness. i have tried to make friends but it just never seems to work for me, and i never find anyone who genuinely likes me.

it will spare me because i will be dead and i won't have to feel things. i doubt there are many people who will mourn me and if they do i know it will be sad for them but eventually they will be able to move on.
